# MCP tool reference

18 tools, mounted at `POST /mcp`. "Scope" is the PAT scope the tool enforces (`write` = `_need_write`; others need `read`). A call that passes authentication and argument validation is audited as `mcp.<tool>`; see the [MCP guide](mcp.md#audit).

## `append_to_handoff`

Append a note to a handoff you can load (needs a write token).

- Scope: `write`
- Label gates: requires the handoff to be loadable by the caller; notes are not label-gated (`handoff.py:append_note`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | yes | `{"maxLength": 200, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `note` | yes | `{"maxLength": 10000, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

## `ask`

Ask a question answered only from library passages the caller may see. Returns the answer with [n] markers and `citations` (doc_id, chunk_id, page, quote). `collection` is an id from list_collections.

- Scope: `read`
- Label gates: exclude_llm applied in ES and Postgres; PAT block_agents (`mcp/tools_write.py:_ask, chat/retrieve.py:147`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `question` | yes | `{"maxLength": 4000, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `collection` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 200, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |

## `check_citations`

Verify each citation (@doc:/@psg: key + its sentence) of a draft you author against the library passages you may read. Returns {version, ok, items}; item = {key, sentence, sentence_hash, status resolved|unresolved, verdict supported|unsupported|unclear, reason, chunk_id, doc_id, title, acknowledged}. Unresolved keys do not exist or are not readable by you (indistinguishable).

- Scope: `write`
- Label gates: exclude_llm draft or cited docs blocked for agents (`writing/cite_check.py:205`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `draft_id` | yes | `{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}` |

## `create_handoff`

Create a handoff (needs a write token) so a person or another agent can continue this work. Documents the caller cannot see are dropped; `dropped` counts requested ids not kept (unknown ids included). Returns code, display, url, uri, dropped.

- Scope: `write`
- Label gates: documents the caller cannot see are dropped (`dropped`), block_agents docs for every caller (`agent_visible`) (`handoff.py:_visible_doc_ids`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | yes | `{"maxLength": 200, "type": "string"}` |
| `brief` | yes | `{"maxLength": 20000, "type": "string"}` |
| `doc_ids` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 500, "type": "array"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `goal` | no | `{"default": "", "maxLength": 2000, "type": "string"}` |
| `audience` | no | `{"default": "creator", "enum": ["creator", "authenticated"], "type": "string"}` |
| `expires_in_days` | no | `{"default": 7, "maximum": 90, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |

## `export_bibtex`

BibTeX for documents (ids and/or one of your collections, at most 200); documents you cannot see are omitted. Returns {bibtex, count}.

- Scope: `read`
- Label gates: block_export labels excluded (`exportable_clause`); unreadable docs omitted (`bibtex.py:83`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `doc_ids` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 200, "type": "array"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `collection` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |

## `get_document`

Get a document's metadata, summary, tags, votes and versions by id.

- Scope: `read`
- Label gates: PAT: `withheld` carries the label name when the text is hidden (`api/routes/documents_read.py:134`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `doc_id` | yes | `{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}` |

## `get_handoff_part`

One page of a handoff's `transcript` or `notes` (20 items per page).

- Scope: `read`
- Label gates: transcript: block_agents sources withheld for every loader, exclude_llm text withheld for agents; notes: not label-gated (free text from creator/agents) (`handoff.py:get_part`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | yes | `{"maxLength": 200, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `part` | no | `{"default": "transcript", "maxLength": 20, "type": "string"}` |
| `page` | no | `{"default": 1, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |

## `get_passages`

Fetch exact passages by chunk_id ("<version_id>:<n>", at most 50). `context` 0..2 adds that many neighbouring chunks either side. Returns text, pages and bboxes; passages the caller cannot see are omitted.

- Scope: `read`
- Label gates: PAT: block_agents docs filtered; exclude_llm/block_agents text replaced by a withheld marker; R19 Postgres re-check (`mcp/server.py:_passages, labels/textgate.py:28`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `chunk_ids` | yes | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 50, "type": "array"}` |
| `context` | no | `{"default": 0, "maximum": 2, "minimum": 0, "type": "integer"}` |

## `list_annotations`

List the notes on a document you may read (oldest first, max 500; anchors re-checked against the latest version, `may_not_apply_to_version` set when the quote moved or vanished).

- Scope: `read`
- Label gates: PAT: block_agents notes/docs hidden; exclude_llm note bodies withheld (`notes/access.py:64, notes/service.py:260`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `doc_id` | yes | `{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}` |

## `list_collections`

List the caller's own collections (id, name, document count, `max_label`: the most sensitive label among the documents you may see in it, null when empty).

- Scope: `read`
- Label gates: none; `max_label` is the most sensitive label among visible docs (`mcp/server.py:_collections`)

No parameters.

## `load_handoff`

Load a handoff (code, XXXX-XXXX, /h/ URL or roracle://handoff/ URI): brief, goal, documents, passages, notes and `parts` page counts for get_handoff_part. Content you cannot see is counted in `withheld`.

- Scope: `read`
- Label gates: block_agents sources withheld from every loader; exclude_llm text withheld for agents (counted in `withheld`); handoff notes are not label-gated (free text from creator/agents) (`handoff.py:view, labels/textgate.py:gated_docs`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | yes | `{"maxLength": 200, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

## `propose_annotation`

Propose a note (needs a write token). Nothing is published: the owner approves it in the proposals inbox. Anchor with `quote` (+ prefix/suffix/page); kind 'relation' needs relation_type and target_doc_id. At most 50 pending proposals per client. Returns {proposal_id, status}.

- Scope: `write`
- Label gates: nothing published until the owner approves; target must be readable incl. the agent gate (`notes/proposals.py:73`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `doc_id` | yes | `{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}` |
| `kind` | yes | `{"enum": ["comment", "finding", "correction", "question", "relation"], "type": "string"}` |
| `body` | yes | `{"maxLength": 10000, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `quote` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 1000, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `prefix` | no | `{"default": "", "maxLength": 200, "type": "string"}` |
| `suffix` | no | `{"default": "", "maxLength": 200, "type": "string"}` |
| `page` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `relation_type` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"enum": ["extends", "contradicts", "replicates", "supersedes"], "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `target_doc_id` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `visibility` | no | `{"default": "private", "enum": ["private", "shared", "everyone"], "type": "string"}` |

## `propose_label`

Propose a sensitivity label (by name) for a document you can read, or for one of its notes with `annotation_id` (needs a write token). Nothing changes until a human approves (lowering needs an admin); `reason` is advisory and not stored, the approver supplies their own. Returns {proposal_id, status}.

- Scope: `write`
- Label gates: nothing changes until a human approves; lowering needs an admin; `reason` not stored (`notes/proposals.py:121`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `doc_id` | yes | `{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}` |
| `label` | yes | `{"maxLength": 40, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `annotation_id` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `reason` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 500, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |

## `reply_to_annotation`

Propose a reply to a note you can read (needs a write token); a human approves it first. Returns {proposal_id, status}.

- Scope: `write`
- Label gates: target note must be readable (`get_readable`: PAT block_agents note gate applies); a human approves first (`notes/access.py:readable_notes, mcp/tools_notes.py:reply_to_annotation`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `annotation_id` | yes | `{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}` |
| `body` | yes | `{"maxLength": 10000, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

## `save_draft`

Save Markdown as a new version of a draft you may edit (needs a write token), or create a draft when `draft_id` is absent (then `title` is required; `profile` optional). Pass `base_version` (the version you last read) to refuse overwriting a newer save. Returns {draft_id, version, url}.

- Scope: `write`
- Label gates: PAT: block_agents draft behaves as non-existent (`writing/drafts.py:33`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `content` | yes | `{"type": "string"}` |
| `draft_id` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `title` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 500, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `profile` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `base_version` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maximum": 2147483647, "minimum": 0, "type": "integer"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |

## `search`

Search the research library (hybrid keyword + semantic). Returns documents the caller may see, each with matching passages and chunk_ids usable with get_passages. `collection` is an id from list_collections; `limit` is 1..50 documents.

- Scope: `read`
- Label gates: block_agents docs absent from results (ES acl filter, PAT); exclude_llm docs return metadata with `withheld: <label>` and no passages; notes via strict gate (`search_acl.py:acl_filter, api/routes/search.py:search (gated_docs), notes/community.py:attach_notes`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | yes | `{"maxLength": 1000, "type": "string"}` |
| `collection` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 200, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `limit` | no | `{"default": 10, "maximum": 50, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |

## `upload`

Upload a document (base64 content; needs a write token; size-capped, larger files use POST /documents). `label` is a sensitivity label name (default: the library default; choosing a lower one than the default is refused). Returns document_id/version_id, or {"duplicate_of": id}. A ZIP/tar/ tar.gz that is not LaTeX source is unpacked: {"archive": true, "documents": [{document_id, version_id, sha256, filename}], "skipped": [{name, reason}]}.

- Scope: `write`
- Label gates: chosen label must rank at least the library default; only an admin on an interactive JWT may go lower, never a PAT (`mcp/tools_write.py:upload, labels/service.py:86`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `filename` | yes | `{"maxLength": 255, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `content_base64` | yes | `{"maxLength": 34952541, "type": "string"}` |
| `title` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 200, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `visibility` | no | `{"default": "private", "enum": ["private", "shared", "org_unit", "everyone"], "type": "string"}` |
| `label` | no | `{"anyOf": [{"maxLength": 40, "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |

## `validate_draft`

Check a draft you may read against its writing profile (structure, limits, notation, acronyms, cross-references, units, AI disclosure, citation keys, LLM style). Returns {version, profile, ok, blocking, warnings}; each finding is {rule, message, line}. Blocking findings must be fixed.

- Scope: `write`
- Label gates: exclude_llm drafts refused for agents (`require_text`) (`writing/validate.py:validate`)

| Parameter | Required | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `draft_id` | yes | `{"maxLength": 100, "type": "string"}` |

## Prompts

- `write_paper` (`topic`, `profile` (optional)): Instructions for writing a paper on `topic` as a rOracle draft under a writing profile.

## Resources

- `roracle://handoff/{code}` (`application/json`): A handoff manifest, same content as load_handoff.
- `roracle://writing/citation-rules` (`text/markdown`): Citation key and verification rules.
- `roracle://writing/profiles` (`application/json`): Effective writing profiles (name, title, version, source).
- `roracle://writing/profiles/{name}` (`application/yaml`): One writing profile as YAML (limits, required sections, template, style guidance).
- `roracle://writing/style-guide` (`text/markdown`): Writing style guide.
